name: Xingzhao Guo
title: Master’s Supervisor
department: School of Mechanical and Power Engineering
tagline: Advancing rehabilitation robotics through intelligent robot control and biomechanical analysis.
biography: Xingzhao Guo is a Master’s Supervisor in the School of Mechanical and Power Engineering at Zhengzhou University. He received his PhD in General Mechanics and Fundamental Mechanics from Peking University. His research focuses on rehabilitation robotics, intelligent robot control, and biomechanical analysis. He has published more than ten SCI/EI/core-indexed papers, filed 14 national invention patent applications, and leads national and provincial research projects. His trunk rehabilitation robot has been evaluated in clinical studies involving more than 50 patients and was featured on CCTV-1 Evening News.
